name: riser_short_2s
desc: Short riser (2 s): filtered noise + detuned saw sweep that builds into a cut.

name: riser_long_4s
desc: Long build-up riser (4 s) with accelerating tremolo – intros, reveals.

name: riser_reverse_cymbal_2s
desc: Reverse-cymbal swell (2 s) that sucks into the cut.

name: riser_tension_3s
desc: Tension riser (3 s): rising detuned synth with speeding tremolo.

name: downlifter_2s
desc: Downlifter (2 s): the riser in reverse – falls away after a drop.

name: pop_soft
desc: Soft pop (90 ms) – captions, stickers, gentle UI pops.

name: pop_hard
desc: Hard pop (80 ms) with a click transient – punchy text slams.

name: pop_bubble
desc: Bubble 'bloop' (120 ms) with an upward pitch – emojis, notifications.

name: pop_click_ui
desc: Tiny UI click (30 ms) – cursor clicks, checkmarks, counters.

name: whoosh_fast
desc: Fast whoosh (0.4 s, panned L→R) – slides and quick transitions.

name: whoosh_slow
desc: Slow airy whoosh (1.2 s) – Ken Burns, fades, soft reveals.

name: whoosh_heavy
desc: Heavy whoosh (0.8 s) with a sub sweep – zoom-throughs, big moves.

name: swoosh_whip
desc: Whip swoosh (0.25 s), bright and snappy – whip pans, Whip-In.

name: whoosh_reverse_suck
desc: Reverse 'suck' whoosh (0.6 s) that ends on the cut.

name: impact_boom
desc: Cinematic boom (1.6 s): sub kick + crack + rumble – Boom Zoom, Impact Hit.

name: impact_punch
desc: Short punchy hit (0.5 s) – shakes, smash cuts, text slams.
